context: A small rural train station. Riku is sitting on a bench at 11am — clearly should be in school. An older country man (Tatsuya) sits down beside him.
purpose: unexpected mentor — country stillness brushes up against urban teen turmoil

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: A whole comfortable silence before this. Tohoku cadence.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Polite mumbled deflection. Eyes on his phone.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Plain question. No accusation in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real beat. The lie too hard to tell.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: うん。…時々、そういう日もあるな。
lines.en: Mm. …Sometimes there are days like that.
lines.style: A small philosophy with no judgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Looks up briefly. Voice cracks half a step.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 本当に。…大丈夫やで、たまになら。
lines.style: A small gift of permission. Real Tohoku warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real beat. The teen-armor lifting a half-step.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: でもな。明日は、行きや。今日だけ。
lines.style: A small firm closing line — voice carries the moment fully.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A small honest line. Voice quieter than the opener.
